title: Two-digit table itoa for selectBytes integer columns
impact: Replaces the single-digit `fast_i64_to_str` body ([exp 023](023-fast-itoa.md)) with a two-digit `[00..99]` lookup table — one `% 100` / `/ 100` and one 2-byte `memcpy` per pair of output digits, halving the division count vs the old loop. Focused `select_bytes_int_heavy.dart` A/B (order-flipped pair): **10k × 8 small ints −11 %, 10k × 20 small ints −8 to −10 %, 10k × 20 big ints (~18 digits) −24 to −26 %**, with mixed-cell and small-payload regression guards inside ±1 %. Adds a 200-byte `kTwoDigits` `const` table; `LLONG_MIN` handling and the `val == 0` short circuit preserved bit-for-bit; new end-to-end int-extremes test covers 0, ±9, ±99, ±10000, ±1234567890, LLONG_MIN, LLONG_MAX through `selectBytes()`
